name: Fujiwara no Yukari
source:
She is a member of the Star Clan who supplies exposition for understanding the game's setting. She has the power to foretell the future. [url=/c26559]Fujihime[/url] is her distant ancestor.
Family: Father and mother (deceased), Grandfather (deceased), Shijo no Amakimi (grandmother), Akifumi's mother (step great-aunt, deceased), Misono (twin brother)
Occupation: Aristocrat

From [url=http://koei.wikia.com/wiki/Harukanaru_Toki_no_Naka_de_2]Koei Wiki[/url]
